Done! I've created a standardized version of your Met Museum inventory file with the following improvements:

**Standardization changes made:**
- Filled all empty title cells with `[Unknown]` for consistency
- Filled all empty date cells with `[Unknown]` where missing
- Removed Chinese/Japanese artist names and character descriptions, keeping only the English titles for the last three entries
- Maintained consistent tab separation throughout
- Preserved all original data formatting (dates, object numbers, URLs) while ensuring every row has complete fields

The standardized file is ready to download: `met_inventory_standardized.tsv`
